items.title: What Are Applied Materials Stock Investors Overlooking?
items.summary: Applied Materials (AMAT) sold a record $7 billion of chipmaking tools in fiscal Q3 2026. That was about 77% of its $9.1 billion in revenue for the quarter. When you own the stock, you mostly own those tool sales. A record that large is easy to read as the new normal. So what might Applied Materials investors be overlooking about those tool sales.

items.title: Is KLA Stock Really Expensive?
items.summary: KLA's market value is 53.2 times its profit over the past twelve months, well above its three-year average of 36 times. A multiple that high means buyers are paying today for profit the company has not earned yet. So is KLA (KLAC) stock really expensive for the growth its business delivers.

items.title: Applied Materials (AMAT) Ties Its $5 Billion EPIC Center To Next Gen AI Memory
items.summary: Applied Materials (NasdaqGS:AMAT) has entered a major R&D partnership with KIOXIA focused on next generation memory for AI workloads. The collaboration will be based at Applied Materials' new US$5b EPIC Center, targeting memory cell structures, multi chip stacking and advanced packaging. Both companies plan to work on improving manufacturability and density of future memory technologies tailored for AI focused chip architectures.
